title: Mem2A receipt
description: Memory's record of an accepted commit. Sent by memory as the single data part (mediaType `application/vnd.mem2a.receipt+json`) of the task artifact with artifactId `receipt`, when the task completes.

recorded.description: The facts memory created from the commit's claims, in the same order. All have status `claim`.

conflictsRecorded.description: How many conflicts from the commit were recorded for a person to review.
